verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken layout. 'BEST TRX' runs over the bottom of the second photo, so the headline sits on a busy image. 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' and 'FREYA ANOUK' are pulled about 130px apart, which splits a single credit into two loose fragments. Small yellow and black deco bars are scattered across a large empty white lower half. A is slightly better because its tall yellow block on the right echoes the original's yellow panel and ties the labels together. B drops that block, adds a stray yellow strip on the left of the photo, and leaves the lower half even emptier and more aimless.
